title: Society for Psychical Research and the history of psychical studies

tellings.quote: Studies have been going on since the 1870s the Society of psychical research

plain: Scientific study of telepathy and other mental powers is said to go back to the 1870s, to the Society for Psychical Research, a group of scholars who investigated such claims. Ky Dickens, maker of a documentary on telepathy, says this on the show without naming a source, citing the scholar Frederick Myers and the psychologist William James as part of that history. She raises it to show that serious people have studied the subject for some 150 years.
